subject: Request: Mercury Analytics pilot - invoice-only / PO waiver
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@mercuryanalytics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (Mercury Analytics)

Hi Rishi,

We’re planning a 90-day pilot of Redwood for a data-augmentation workflow and would like to start as soon as possible. Procurement at Mercury follows a strict PO process, but given the pilot size (expected spend under $5,000 total) we’re requesting an invoice-only onboarding path / temporary PO waiver so we can invoice monthly while the pilot runs.

Quick details:
- Pilot length: 90 days
- Estimated spend: ~$3,500–$4,800 total
- Billing cadence requested: monthly invoices (Net 30)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can onboard Mercury on an invoice-only basis for this pilot and what evidence/forms you need? I attached a filled vendor contact sheet to speed things up.

Thanks,

Elena Park
Head of Procurement, Mercury Analytics
elena@mercuryanalytics.com
Attachment: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@mercuryanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (Mercury Analytics)

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the form. Appreciate the clarity on the pilot window and estimated spend.

We can consider a temporary invoice-only path for small pilots, but we need to confirm a few items with Procurement and Finance before I can sign off:
- Completed onboarding form (got the contact sheet; thanks)
- Proof of business (W-9 / company registration) and a current SOC 2 report or equivalent security attestation
- Billing contact and invoicing email

I’ve cc’d Marissa (Procurement) and Karthik (Legal) to start an internal review. If you can also attach the SOW you mentioned, that will help with our internal risk assessment.

Next steps on our side: I’ll push this to Procurement for a one-off waiver decision and come back with required controls and any cap/conditions.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
Attachment: (referenced) Mercury-SOW-Redwood-2026.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding without PO for pilot (Mercury Analytics)

Forwarding Mercury’s request — they want invoice-only (no PO) for a 90-day pilot estimated under $5k.

Summary:
- Account: Mercury Analytics (contact: Elena Park, elena@mercuryanalytics.com)
- Pilot: 90 days, estimated total $3.5k–$4.8k, monthly invoices
- Attachments from vendor: completed vendor contact sheet (vendor-onboarding-form.pdf), SOW (Mercury-SOW-Redwood-2026.pdf) — attached to this thread.

As this is a small-dollar pilot, I’m requesting Procurement consider a temporary waiver to our PO requirement with these guardrails:
- Approval window: 90 days from activation date
- Monthly invoice cap: $5,000
- Vendor must complete onboarding and provide W-9 + SOC 2 attestation before first invoice is processed
- One-time waiver recorded to the vendor record with a link to the SOW/HubSpot deal (HS-2345)

Please let me know what evidence you need; I’ve included a procurement evidence bundle (procurement-evidence.zip) in case you want the W-9 / contract redlines / background. If approved, we’ll need an internal tracking note and a single-line exception recorded so Accounting can route invoices to Net 30.

Thanks — I’m happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

— Rishi

Rishi — reviewed and approved with the following conditions:

Decision: APPROVED (temporary PO waiver)
Conditions to record and enforce:
1) Length: 90-day waiver from activation (max 90 days).
2) Financial cap: invoices during the waiver period must not exceed $5,000 in total; Accounting will block anything above $5k.
3) Required vendor evidence: completed onboarding form, W-9, and SOC 2 (or recent security questionnaire).
4) Contract/SOW: reference the attached SOW (Mercury-SOW-Redwood-2026.pdf) and record the HubSpot deal HS-2345.
5) Single-line exception: Procurement will add a one-time waiver note to Mercury’s vendor profile and flag the Accounting routing code so invoices are processed Net 30.
6) Review: this waiver will auto-expire after 90 days; any continued relationship must move to standard PO flow or a reserved capacity contract.

Action items for Rishi / Sales:
- Confirm activation date with the Mercury billing contact so Procurement can stamp the waiver start date.
- Ensure vendor uploads W-9 and SOC2 to the secure portal before first invoice.
- Send Accounting the vendor onboarding package and this approval note (procurement will cc Accounting).

I’ve attached the procurement evidence bundle we used in the review for the record. If you want an exception memo for Finance, I can generate it and route it for signature.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: procurement-evidence.zip (contains W-9, SOC2 extract, vendor risk memo)
